description: This file defines a readonly struct named CorrelationId used for uniquely identifying correlations within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for generation, comparison, formatting, and interop with external systems.

classes.name: CorrelationId
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a unique correlation identifier, encapsulating a long value, with methods for creation, comparison, string formatting, and equality checks.

methods.description: Constructor that takes a long value to initialize the CorrelationId.

methods.description: Generates a new CorrelationId with a unique value by incrementing a static lastUsed counter.

methods.description: Returns the hash code for the correlation id.

methods.description: Checks equality with another object or CorrelationId.

methods.description: Formats the id as a string with a specified format string and provider.
